data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 1910 reports a gross prior-year reserve release of approximately GBP 45.34m (-10.1% of opening gross claims outstanding GBP 448.1m), primarily attributed to favourable claims development on longer-tail and specialty classes affecting the 2021 and 2022 underwriting years. The syndicate noted material 2024 catastrophe activity (including hurricanes Helene and Milton, a major Canadian catastrophe and the Baltimore bridge allision) which increased gross and net claims during the year, but the prior-year reserve movement reported in the technical provisions is a net release driven by improved experience on older years, particularly across its reinsurance (treaty/specialty) portfolio.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development (PYD) taken from the technical provisions reconciliation line 'Change in estimates of prior year provisions (45,340)' (gross, GBP 000) and converted to millions = -45.34 (release). A gross claims development triangle is available and was cross-checked; the triangle's column-wise comparisons for underwriting years 2022 produced a small net adverse movement (~+11.93m) which conflicts with the prior-year provision line. The reconciliation/triangle may be affected by RITC and other opening adjustments; per the report an RITC/opening adjustment exists. Chosen primary PYD source: explicit gross 'change in estimates of prior year provisions' line. Numbers in main fields are in millions (as required); the claims development triangle is reported in the original units (thousands) and may include RITC distortions.
